items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 20 September 2026 at 9:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the south of England, with a ridge covering the Irish Sea. Low pressure near Greenland, driving a weak warm front across the area tomorrow morning.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 3 or 4, backing South or Southwest by midnight, occasionally touching 5 in places tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle overnight and tomorrow morning, becoming mainly fair. Risk of mist patches later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain, drizzle or mist patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 2 to 4.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Risk of mist patches.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in mist patches.
